item.title: To Offset China, the US Must Engage with the Caspian Region
item.description: The Donald Trump administration’s recent slew of deals in Central Asia must be accompanied by the removal of congressional roadblocks to further regional cooperation. The post To Offset China, the US Must Engage with the Caspian Region appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Facing Sanctions, Putin’s Shadow Fleet Keeps Russia Afloat
item.description: Russia has used its Shadow Fleet to export seized Ukrainian grain, as well as oil. The post Facing Sanctions, Putin’s Shadow Fleet Keeps Russia Afloat appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Sorry, Russia: India Just Doesn’t Want Your Fifth-Gen Fighter
item.description: India won’t be “quitting” Russia anytime soon, as it still needs Russian military platforms, but New Delhi is all-in on developing indigenous platforms. The post Sorry, Russia: India Just Doesn’t Want Your Fifth-Gen Fighter appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: South Korean K2 Black Panther Tanks Are Heading to Peru
item.description: Though Korea and Peru are on opposite sides of the globe, they have a similar climate and geography, making the Black Panther easy to adapt for Peruvian conditions. The post South Korean K2 Black Panther Tanks Are Heading to Peru appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How Decades of Failed Governance Poisoned Iran’s Air
item.description: The human and economic costs of Iran’s poor air quality are an indictment of the Islamic Republic’s corrupt governance. The post How Decades of Failed Governance Poisoned Iran’s Air appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How the AV-8B Harrier “Jump Jet” Revolutionized Vertical Takeoff Technology
item.description: The AV-8B Harrier is now nearly retired—but its mission profile will live on in the F-35B Lightning II, which shares many of the same capabilities. The post How the AV-8B Harrier “Jump Jet” Revolutionized Vertical Takeoff Technology appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How the Soviet Union Accidentally Helped America Build the F-117 Nighthawk
item.description: The groundbreaking “Have Blue” design, which ultimately became the F-117 Nighthawk, relied heavily on research conducted by Soviet physicist Pyotr Ufimtsev. The post How the Soviet Union Accidentally Helped America Build the F-117 Nighthawk appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Does the B-2 Spirit Bomber Cost So Much to Fly?
item.description: The small number of B-2s in the Air Force’s inventory—and the labor-intensive process of maintaining its stealth coating—put ongoing maintenance costs as high as $200,000 per flight hour. The post Why Does the B-2 Spirit Bomber Cost So Much to Fly? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The A-10 Warthog Has Guardian Angels in Congress
item.description: Supporters of the A-10 have argued that no other aircraft, notably the F-35 Lightning II, can fill the Thunderbolt II’s role. The post The A-10 Warthog Has Guardian Angels in Congress appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Turkey Cannot Be Trusted in Gaza
item.description: Unless Ankara changes its course, Hamas is likely to benefit from any inclusion of Turkey in the process of stabilizing and reconstructing the Gaza Strip. The post Why Turkey Cannot Be Trusted in Gaza appeared first on The National Interest.
